_note: Hand-extracted by Claude from Apify batch-1 snapshots on 2026-11-03. status=extracted. Every rule needs human review before publishing. Quotes are internal only.

rules.value_text: No fixed return window for most merchandise (satisfaction guarantee).
rules.quote: We guarantee your satisfaction on every product we sell, and will refund your purchase price

rules.scope_category: electronics (TVs, projectors, major appliances, computers, tablets, smart wearables, cameras, drones, camcorders, MP3 players, cell phones)
rules.value_text: 90 days from the date the member received the item.
rules.quote: Costco will accept returns within 90 days (from the date the member received the merchandise)

rules.value_text: Membership fee refundable at any time if dissatisfied.
rules.quote: We will cancel and refund your membership fee at any time if you are dissatisfied.

rules.value_text: Non-refundable: airline and live-event items, precious metals, Shop Cards, gift cards and tickets; custom/special-order items (warranty only); cigarettes and alcohol where prohibited by law.
Original IGI/GIA paperwork required; a Jewelry Credit Memo is issued pending gemologist inspection within 48 hours.
rules.quote: Members returning a diamond over 1.00ct must also present all original paperwork

rules.value_text: 90 days for most items (in-store and Walmart.com).
rules.quote: You have 90 days after purchase or upon receipt to return most items unless noted in our exceptions.

rules.value_text: Items sold and shipped by Marketplace sellers: 30 days.
rules.quote: Items sold and shipped by a Marketplace seller may be returned within 30 days.
Most Consumer Electronics are returnable within 30 days.
Wireless phones are returnable within 14 days.

rules.value_text: Most items bought Oct 1–Dec 31 are returnable until Jan 31. Marketplace seller participation varies.
rules.quote: Most items purchased in-store or online from October 1 through December 31 are returnable until January 31.

rules.value_text: Items bought from dealers or resellers (not Walmart directly) are not eligible.
rules.quote: Items purchased from dealers or resellers and not Walmart or Walmart.com directly aren't eligible for return, refund, or exchange.
